faces.name: In Thrall to the Pit
faces.oracleText:
Kicker {2}{B} (You may pay an additional {2}{B} as you cast this spell.)
Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, sacrifice that creature at the beginning of the next end step.

faces.name: In the Darkness Bind Them
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after IV.)
I, II, III — Create a 3/3 black Wraith creature token with menace. The Ring tempts you.
IV — For each opponent, gain control of up to one target creature that player controls until end of turn. Untap those creatures. They gain haste until end of turn. The Ring tempts you.

faces.name: In the Eye of Chaos
faces.oracleText: Whenever a player casts an instant spell, counter it unless that player pays {X}, where X is its mana value.

faces.name: In the Pale Moonlight
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.
II — Investigate. (Create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
III — You may sacrifice an artifact or creature. If you do, create two 2/2 black Romulan creature tokens.

faces.name: In the Presence of Ages
faces.oracleText: Reveal the top four cards of your library. You may put a creature card and/or a land card from among them into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.

faces.name: In the Trenches
faces.oracleText:
Creatures you control get +1/+1.
{5}{W}: Exile target nonland permanent you don't control until this enchantment leaves the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery and only once.

faces.name: In the Web of War
faces.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters, it gets +2/+0 and gains haste until end of turn.
